proposals.title: Proposal 6 — Shareholder Ratification of Termination Pay
proposals.topic_summary: Requests shareholder approval of any senior manager's pay package providing severance or termination payments exceeding 2.99 times base salary plus target short-term bonus.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 6.

proposals.title: Proposal 7 – Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring separate persons to hold the Chairman and CEO offices, with the Chairman being an Independent Director whenever possible.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 7.

proposals.title: Proposal 8
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Joseph of Peace, the Sisters of St. Dominic of Caldwell, NJ, The Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia, and United Church Funds
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the effectiveness of Citi's policies and performance in respecting Indigenous Peoples' human rights in corporate and project financing.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 8.

proposals.title: Proposal 9
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy for a time-bound phase out of Citi's lending and underwriting to companies and projects engaging in new fossil fuel exploration and development.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 9.
